Manage ycy configuration

Usage:
  ycy config [flags]
  ycy config [command]

Available Commands:
  cm          Manage CM profiles
  fork        Manage git fork provider instances

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for config

Global Flags:
      --log-format string   Diagnostic format: text or json
      --log-level string    Log level: debug, info, warn, or error
      --quiet               Only emit error diagnostics (short form: -q)
  -v, --verbose             Enable debug diagnostics

Use "ycy config [command] --help" for more information about a command.
